name: ed-narrator-studio
description: Make a narrated product demo end to end: capture the app, add motion design (2D, 3D, cinematic), voice it with ED Narrator, mix background music, and install voices when needed.

app_url.title: ED Narrator address
app_url.description: Loopback address of the running app. Use port 8090 for Docker or the address shown in Guide > Connect to Claude.

input_dirs.title: Allowed media folders
input_dirs.description: Only these folders can be read. Use the OS path separator between folders; never use your home folder itself.

output_dir.title: Output folder
output_dir.description: Folder where narrated videos and other results are saved.
